verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the Drive API OAuth scope description, which shows that apps can delete the Drive files they use. That is a thin first-party indication of programmatic deletion, with no retention controls documented. Community mentions of rclone backups are user-side workarounds and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented retention policies or settings, trash/permanent-deletion behavior and timelines, account-level data deletion controls, AI-data retention controls, and independent corroboration.
